comparison.objective: Lower a bent steel tube into a checking fixture so all four legs enter their slots together.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually hold a rigid spatial tube level and achieve simultaneous multi-point alignment without catching or dropping it.
comparison.success_condition: All four legs rest on their slot floors, the tube is released and still, and excessive drop height invalidates the result.
comparison.reason: The record lacks indexed task.json/spec versions and a complete partial-score rubric, but its body clearly tests simultaneous fixture seating rather than adjustment, threaded locking, or cycling.
